ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Privilege Escalation via Service Permissions Weakness
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect modification of services configuration (ImagePath, FailureCommand and ServiceDLL) in registry by processes with Medium integrity level

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "Medium" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-8192") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ControlSet.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*services.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ImagePath.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\FailureCommand.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ServiceDll.*")))
